t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes in the tall hat are the best ones to chose. Also, the pink, blue and purple gnomes offer more mushrooms. Avoid red and brown gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: Try each option yourself and find a pattern that works for you. Follow your own instinct and try to stick to a colour or side that seems to work the best. The game will change throughout, so try not to get too set in a particular way.
